select t.validStatus, t.periodProdId, t.periodId, to_char(t.investCycle) investCycle, t.publishType, t.rateType, t.rateLower, t.rateLimit, t.rate, t.indexId, t.coefficient, t.spreadRate, t.resetType, t.termType, t.baseRule, t.startDate, t.endDate, t.p_finprod_id as finprodId, t.branch from( select '有效' validStatus, ftp.finprod_id periodProdId, ftp.period_id periodId, ftp.term investCycle, ftp.vdate startDate, ftp.mdate endDate, fbri.publish_type publishType, fbri.rate_type rateType, fbri.rate_lower *100 rateLower, fbri.rate_limit *100 rateLimit, fbri.rate * 100 rate, fbri.index_id indexId, fbri.coefficient, fbri.spread_rate *100 spreadRate, fbri.reset_type resetType, fpa.term_type termType, case when fbri.publish_type = #{publishType01} then to_char(dec(fbri.rate_lower *100, 10,7)) || '~' || to_char(dec(fbri.rate_limit *100, 10,7)) when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType01} then to_char(dec(fbri.rate * 100, 10,7)) when fbri.rate_type = #{calcType02} then fbri.index_id ||'*'|| to_char(fbri.coefficient) ||'+'||to_char(dec(fbri.spread_rate*100,10,7)) end as baseRule, fp.p_finprod_id, ftp.branch from fin_trade_product ftp left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id left join fin_base_rule_info fbri on fbri.finprod_id = ftp.finprod_id and fbri.branch = ftp.branch left join fin_product_add fpa on fpa.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id
inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa on fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID = ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID and ppa.USER_ID = #{userId}
where fbri.eff_date = ( select max(t.eff_date) from fin_base_rule_info t where t.base_rule_id = fbri.base_rule_id and t.branch != 0 and t.eff_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) and fbri.base_rule_type = #{baseRuleType01} and ftp.finprod_type2 = #{F26} ) t
and t.p_finprod_id in
#{item}
and t.startDate >= to_date(#{startDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.startDate <= to_date(#{startDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.endDate >= to_date(#{endDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and t.endDate <= to_date(#{endDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
